title: PayGuard AI Shared Contract
description: Unified system contract for Blue guard, Red attacker, mock chain, collector, and frontend dashboard.

paymentRequirements.maxAmountRequired: string (atomic integer as string — never a float)

decision.attackType: OVERPAYMENT | WRONG_RECIPIENT | FAKE_TOKEN | WRONG_NETWORK | EXPIRED_PAYMENT | REPLAY_ATTACK | DOMAIN_SPOOF | TOCTOU_MODIFY | BUDGET_EXHAUST | INVALID_SCHEMA | null

event_schema.data: object — no private keys, no secrets, no raw credentials

kind.description: CRITICAL: POLICY_APPROVED, SIGNER_CALLED, and CHAIN_TRANSFERRED are separate events

layer.description: Guard layer that produced this event (L0-L8)

pin_hash.description: sha256: prefixed hash of the pinned quote

trace_id.description: Correlation ID across layers for one payment attempt

amount_atomic.description: Payment amount in atomic units as integer string

attack.description: Attack ID if from Red team (A1-A18)

chain_delta_atomic.description: Actual balance delta from mock chain

funds_lost_atomic.description: Funds lost per mock chain confirmation

collector.POST /events: Submit a structured or guard event
collector.GET /events: SSE stream or paginated list of all events
collector.GET /metrics: Live computed defense metrics and latency

blue_agent.POST /shield-check: Zero-trust 6-layer firewall validation of payment requirements
blue_agent.POST /agent/run: Autonomous agent task execution with firewall protection
blue_agent.GET /merchants: List of trusted providers from registry

mock_chain.GET /balances: Read all account balances (read-only neutral ledger)
mock_chain.POST /transfer: Execute token transfer on mock chain
mock_chain.POST /reset: Reset chain state to initial balances

red_merchant.POST /checkout: Initiate 402 payment challenge (supports normal and hostile modes)

red_console.POST /attacks/run: Execute single attack scenario against Blue
red_console.POST /attacks/run-all: Execute full test matrix against Blue
red_console.GET /status: Current status and adaptive UCB1 stats

security_notes: Private keys, signing secrets, and mnemonic phrases MUST NEVER appear in event payloads, logs, HTTP responses, or source code.
funds_lost_atomic is confirmed by the mock chain ONLY — never inferred solely by guard approval.
CRITICAL SEPARATION: POLICY_APPROVED ≠ SIGNER_INVOKED ≠ FUNDS_TRANSFERRED. These three events are separate and must never be conflated.
All amounts are atomic integer strings (BigInt-safe). No USD floats in payment amounts or cryptographic payloads.
TOCTOU protection requires intent fingerprint verification at the actual signing boundary.
